ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory screening against the FATF 40 Recommendations PEP standard, the United Nations Security Council Consolidated List, the OFAC SDN List, the UK HM Treasury sanctions list, and Belize domestic terrorist/sanctions listings; enhanced due diligence required for all PEPs, PEP family members, and close associates; UBO identity verified by the IFSC-licensed registered agent at the statutory 25% ownership threshold; ongoing transaction monitoring and rolling screening every 48 hours throughout the incorporation process and thereafter under the Money Laundering and Terrorism (Prevention) Act, Chapter 104

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: Belize Companies and Corporate Affairs Registry (CCAR) - Belize Corporate Registry and e-filing platform (name search and reservation module)
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: The statutory language of Belize is English; a corporate name must be rendered entirely in the Latin/Roman alphabet; non-Latin names (e.g., a Chinese trade name used for the boba tea franchise) must be romanized/transliterated for the official registered name and have no separate legal effect; no bilingual statutory requirement applies; the registered name must end with a statutory suffix, namely 'Limited', 'Ltd.', 'Corporation', 'Corp.', 'Incorporated', 'Inc.', 'Societe Anonyme', or 'S.A.'
prohibited_and_sensitive_tokens: Belize (in a context implying state sponsorship or misleading official connection)
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: Upon name rejection, the applicant or its IFSC-licensed registered agent may within 14 days file a written administrative appeal with the Registrar of Companies under the International Business Companies Act, Chapter 270, demonstrating compliance with the naming requirements; the Registrar must determine the appeal within 30 days; if the refusal is upheld, the applicant may immediately reserve an alternate name for a new 30-day window, or seek judicial review before the Supreme Court of Belize within 21 days of the final refusal; a written request for a one-time extension of an existing name reservation (up to 30 additional days) may be submitted before expiry, subject to Registrar discretion and payment of the statutory extension fee

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: Permissible as a registered-process and domiciliation address where provided by an IFSC-licensed registered agent in Belize; a virtual office satisfies the statutory IBC registered-office obligation but does NOT constitute commercial substance for external tax-residency claims; the franchise holding and royalty-licensing activity must retain demonstrable and verifiable economic substance in its intended residence jurisdiction
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: Low (approximately 10-15% annualized) for a standard low-risk IBC serving as a franchise royalty and syrup-supply-chain holding vehicle; the likelihood rises to approximately 30-40% if the entity is selected under the IFSC risk-based supervision sampling cycle, or if a correspondent bank, the Financial Intelligence Unit, or a foreign competent authority initiates an enquiry; unannounced physical inspections are legally authorized under the IFSC supervision framework

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: International Business Companies Act, Cap. 270 (Laws of Belize, Revised Edition), as amended; specifically ss. 5 (incorporation), 13 (registered office), 16 (directors), 26 (registered agent) and 38 (authorized capital records).
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Companies and Corporate Affairs Registry (CCAR), Belize City, Ministry of Attorney General, Government of Belize.
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Memorandum and Articles of Association together with Incorporation Application Form BZ-IBC-1, filed through the Belize Companies Registry e-Filing Portal.
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No minimum paid-up capital is required for an IBC. Authorized capital may be expressed in any currency; issued shares may be nominal, commonly USD 1 per subscriber share. No statutory escrow account is required, and paid-up capital may be credited in exchange for property, services, or as loan capital.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: RESOLVED, in accordance with the International Business Companies Act, Cap. 270, that: (1) The incorporation application of BZ__BZ__BZ_IBC__ISIC_5610_01_BOBA_TEA_GLOBAL_FRANCHISE filed with the Companies and Corporate Affairs Registry be and is hereby ratified and adopted. (2) Each subscribing shareholder shall be allotted fully paid shares as set forth in the register of members. (3) The registered office of the Company be established at the office of the duly licensed registered agent named in the Certificate of Incorporation. (4) The registered agent is authorized to receive legal process and statutory notices. (5) [Director Name] is appointed President/Director and [Officer Name] is appointed Secretary/Treasurer. (6) All pre-incorporation acts, contracts, and costs are ratified. This resolution is immediate and remains in full force until revoked.

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Companies and Corporate Affairs Registry (CCAR) Name Reservation Desk, Belize City / e-Filing Portal.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit an online name reservation request for the proposed IBC name and two alternatives. The Registry checks the name against the national corporate and intellectual property registers. A name may be reserved for a non-extendable period of 90 days while the incorporation documents are prepared.
required_dossiers: Primary proposed corporate name
At least two alternative names
Subscriber identification data and nationality
Proof of payment of name reservation fee
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the name is refused, file a written administrative reconsideration within 21 days; alternatively select a new name, add a distinctive propose­ful mark or acronym, and resubmit the reservation application.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Preparation and Execution of Constitutional Documents
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Subscribers, founder, and licensed Belize registered agent.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Draft the Memorandum and Articles of Association, set authorized capital and share classes, appoint initial directors, and provide for the registered office and registered agent. Each subscriber executes the memorandum and articles. Signatures may be witnessed; notarization is not statutorily mandatory for a Belize IBC but is commonly obtained for banking acceptance.
required_dossiers: Memorandum and Articles of Association drafts
Consent to act as each initial director
Subscriber identity documents (passport, proof of residence)
Stock subscription list with share allocations
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the Registry flags the constitutional documents, cure by revising the defective clauses, obtaining fresh signatures, resubmitting the corrected instrument, and paying the administrative correction fee if applicable.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Filing of Incorporation Application and Issuance of Certificate
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Companies and Corporate Affairs Registry (CCAR), Registrar of International Business Companies.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit the Incorporation Application Form BZ-IBC-1 together with the signed Memorandum and Articles, Statement of Authorized Capital, and registered agent consent. Pay the official state registration fee of US$100. After validation, the Registrar issues a Certificate of Incorporation under the International Business Companies Act and files the constitutional documents.
required_dossiers: Completed Incorporation Application Form BZ-IBC-1
Signed Memorandum and Articles of Association
Statement of authorized capital and share classes
Consent of the Belize registered agent and registered office
Proof of paid official government fee
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the application is queried, provide the requested clarification, correct formatting or incomplete fields, and resubmit within 14 days. Where the query concerns an unlicensed registered agent, the applicant must appoint a licensed agent and file an amended consent before the certificate can be issued.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Register of Members, Directors, and Registered Office Post-Incorporation
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Registered agent and initial directors under the supervision of the Registrar.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: After the Certificate of Incorporation is issued, the registered agent opens the statutory registers: register of members, directors, officers, and charges. The registered office and agent details are recorded and an annual license fee schedule is set. Statutory registers may be kept at the registered office or another location notified to the Registrar.
required_dossiers: Certificate of Incorporation
Register of shareholders
Register of directors and officers
Registered office consent with physical address
Registered agent consent
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If a statutory record is rejected or inconsistent, prepare a corrective declaration, file a rectification form with the Registrar, and pay the required filing fee to update the record. Delays are cured by filing a Statement of Corrective Entry.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: First Board Resolutions and Organizational Actions
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Board of Directors of the IBC; meetings may be held by telephone or unanimous written resolution under the IBC Act.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Call a first board meeting or pass a unanimous written resolution to issue shares, adopt the corporate minute book, approve the registered office, appoint directors and officers, adopt the corporate seal, open banking relations, and authorize issuance of share certificates. The resolution must be signed or confirmed by all directors.
required_dossiers: Notice of first board meeting or unanimous written resolution
Draft first board resolution (pro-forma resolution as adopted)
Register of directors and officers
Office appointment consents
Authorized signatory list for bank accounts
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the board resolution is challenged by a shareholder or state authority, ratify and confirm the actions through a subsequent unanimous written resolution with effective retrospective effect, provided the actions were within the objects of the Company and lawful.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Obtaining Certified Corporate Outstanding and Good Standing Evidence
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Apply for a Certificate of Good Standing, a Certificate of Incumbency, and certified copies of the Memorandum and Articles, together with any registered agent certification needed for bank onboarding and franchise licensing. Ensure all annual fees are paid or waived for newly incorporated IBCs as applicable.
required_dossiers: Certificate of Incorporation
Certificate of Good Standing application form
Certificate of Incumbency request
Copy of authorized capital statement
Current registered agent certification
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the good standing certificate is refused due to an outstanding regulatory filing, settle the arrears, file the overdue annual return or license fee, and request expedited certification. If the Registry made an administrative error, file a correction request with evidence of identity and original filing receipt.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Belize Trade and Investment Development Service (BELTRAIDE), Belize Bureau of Standards (BBS), and Ministry of Health and Wellness – Food Safety Unit.
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Trade License for Commercial Operations and Food Manufacturing Establishment License (for syrup/beverage concentrate production and franchise supply operations).

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Department of the Environment, Ministry of Sustainable Development, Climate Change and Disaster Risk Management, Belize.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Category B – Environmental Compliance Plan (ECP) and EIA Registration are required for food/beverage processing at moderate scale; a Full EIA Report is mandated for large-capacity manufacturing or discharge-sensitive locations. Small laboratory-scale syrup blending is registered under the Environmental Compliance Plan rather than full EIA.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: All wastewater effluent must meet Belize Effluent Quality Criteria: BOD5 ≤ 30 mg/L, COD ≤ 120 mg/L, TSS ≤ 30 mg/L, pH 6-9, oil/grease ≤ 10 mg/L. No untreated process wastewater may be discharged into watercourses. VOC emissions from syrup heating, flavoring, and bottling areas must comply with the Belize Air Quality Regulations, including workplace exposure limits. Solid waste and packaging must be handled by a licensed waste management operator.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Prior to operation, the facility must obtain fire safety certification from the Belize Fire Service under the Civil Defense Act; structural load inspection and occupancy permit from the local building authority/planning authority; and occupational clearance from the Labor Department for workplace safety, sanitation, and staff welfare facilities.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Belize Tax Service Department (Ministry of Finance, Government of Belize); self-service portal: https://taxbelize.gov.bz
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: Foreign entities forming a Belize International Business Company (IBC) under the International Business Companies Act (Cap. 270) are not required to obtain a local VAT/TIN for offshore activities; IBCs by definition are tax-exempt outside Belize and prohibited from conducting business with residents. Should the entity elect in-country taxable activity, it must file Form GST-01 with the Tax Service Department, provide certificate of incorporation, registered office consent, and evidence of physical premises or local agent, after which the Department assigns a GST registration number. Non-resident franchise operators supplying intangible services into Belize may also be required to register for GST if their annual taxable supplies to Belize exceed the statutory threshold.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: No check-the-box election exists. An IBC automatically qualifies for exemption from all Belize income and business taxes under section 7(1) of the IBC Act. The entity may irrevocably waive IBC status (electing to become a Belizean domestic ordinary company) by filing Form IBC-5, thereby becoming subject to domestic CIT and GST regimes. Hybrid mismatch elections are not available under Belizean law.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: General Sales Tax (GST) – Value Added Tax regime
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: BZD 75,000 (annual taxable turnover) — mandatory registration threshold; supplies of exported goods and certain offshore services are zero-rated or exempt.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: No real-time fiscal clearance or government mandated e-invoice API exists. GST-registered businesses may issue manual or electronic invoices, but must issue a tax invoice containing prescribed particulars (seller name, GST number, invoice date, description, TIN of buyer, tax exclusive value, tax amount, and total). No digital stamping requirement is currently enforced.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: GST zero-rating applies to (i) the export of goods out of Belize; (ii) supply of services physically performed entirely outside Belize; (iii) international transport services; and (iv) supplies of intellectual property or know-how to non-resident licensees where the benefit of the supply is outside Belize. For a boba tea global franchise IBC licensing intellectual property and selling syrup concentrate to overseas franchisees, royalty payments and syrup exports will qualify for 0% GST provided the goods are physically exported and the services are rendered outside Belize and not consumed in Belize.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Customs Export Declaration (Form C-2) stamped by Belize Customs and Excise Department
Signed Bill of Lading / Airway Bill evidencing physical departure from Belize
Commercial Invoice showing purchaser as non-resident and zero-rated basis
Inward Remittance Certificate or bank wire confirmatory proof of receipt of export proceeds
License Agreement (for royalty zero-rating) with provision showing delivery of IP to foreign franchisee
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: Under the General Sales Tax Act (Cap. 287), a taxpayer who fraudulently claims zero-rating on non-exported goods or fictitious supplies is liable to a penalty of 200% of the tax evaded, plus interest, and criminal fines up to BZD 10,000 or imprisonment of up to 2 years. The Tax Service Department may retrospectively claw back input tax credits claimed in connection with zero-rated outputs if the exporter fails to provide the required export documentation within the 180-day repatriation window, and cancellation of GST registration may follow.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: Central Bank of Belize (CBB) — Exchange Control Department, acting under the Exchange Control Act, Chapter 56 of the Laws of Belize
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: The Belize dollar is legally pegged to the U.S. dollar at BZD 2 : USD 1. Belize maintains selective exchange control: current-account payments for trade, royalties, and services are generally permitted and cleared by authorized dealers, subject to documentary, anti-money-laundering, and sanctions screening. Capital-account transactions involving residents require Central Bank approval. A validly registered International Business Company is treated as non-resident for exchange-control purposes if its activities and income are outside Belize; therefore capital injection and profit or royalty remittance should not be denied on convertibility grounds. In practice, Belizean banks will require an underlying contract, board resolution, source-of-funds evidence, UBO declaration, and OFAC/correspondent-bank clearance before any large outward or inward transfer.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: Under the Belize Exchange Control Regulations, a resident exporter must receive export proceeds through an authorized dealer in the currency of invoice and surrender/offer the proceeds for conversion to Belize dollars within 90 days of exportation, unless a specific retention exemption is granted. The mandatory conversion ratio is 100% of foreign currency receipted where no exemption applies. A Belize IBC that does not carry on business in Belize, does not receive export proceeds in the domestic banking system, and holds receivables in an approved offshore foreign-currency account is generally outside this surrender requirement. For the target boba tea franchise model, export proceeds arising from syrup supply contracts are treated as ordinary trading proceeds and should be routed through fully documented commercial invoices, transport documentation, and collection accounts to avoid any mischaracterization.

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: Operational Treasury Account; USD/BZD Wired Settlement Account
Operational Account with Capital Escrow Sub-ledger
Offshore International Account; IBC Operating Account
Domestic Operational Account; Limited Foreign-Currency Services
USD Corporate Account; Trade Finance and LC Account

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Feasibility rating: Low-to-Medium. Belize does not operate a dedicated e-money institution licensing regime. Offshore digital EMIs operating under UK, EU, or Hong Kong licenses are not supervised by the Central Bank of Belize and generally reject Belize IBC clients due to correspondent-bank de-risking and the jurisdiction's offshore-characteristics profile. Mainstream EMIs such as Wise, Payoneer, and Airwallex are not viable primary clearing rails for this IBC. They may be used only as auxiliary low-value collection tools for franchise royalty aggregation if the EMI accepts Belize corporate clients after enhanced due diligence, but a Belize licensed bank account remains the principal liquidity and clearing channel.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: In-person KYC interview is expected and is effectively mandatory for all non-resident directors and UBOs when onboarding a new Belize IBC. Domestic banks generally require physical presentation of original passports, proof of address, corporate documents, and signatory instructions before activating accounts. Remote opening is available only on an exceptional basis for existing private-bank relationships or with a licensed introducer, apostilled notarized documents, video identity verification, and a local corporate-services provider acting as referrer. The franchise entity should plan for board members or an authorized officer with a valid power of attorney to attend an in-person interview in Belize City or at a recognized overseas branch/affiliate.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Offshore IBC with no physical business presence, no substance documentation, and no clear commercial rationale for a Belize account
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Certificate of Registration, Belize IBC public register extract, certificate of incumbency, registered-agent confirmation, current board resolution authorizing account opening, substance and economic-purpose declaration for the franchise business, office-services agreement (if any), and a credible business plan describing royalty flows and syrup supply-chain volumes.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Non-resident directors or UBOs located in multiple or higher-risk jurisdictions; incomplete beneficial-ownership chain or nominee shareholder concerns
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Up-to-date beneficial-ownership register, notarized passport copies, proof of residential address, source-of-wealth statement, professional CV/business background, group structure chart, and, where any trust appears in the ownership chain, the trust deed, trustee declarations, and protector letters.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Franchise royalty model involving payments from several franchisees and potential third-party layering of funds
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Master franchise agreements, detailed royalty fee schedule, franchisee due-diligence files, invoicing and payment reconciliation reports, monthly royalty statements, trademark and IP registration certificates, and a consolidated transaction-flow map showing all franchisee remittances.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Initial capital injection from personal accounts or indirect corporate sources inconsistent with declared franchise capital needs
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Capital subscription agreement, issued share certificates, bank statements evidencing the complete remitting chain, source-of-funds affidavit, tax-residence certificates of the shareholders, and an accountant's verification report or audited financial statements for the investing entity.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: High expected volume of outbound wire transfers to low-tax jurisdictions characterized as management fees, royalties, or intercompany charges
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Executed commercial contracts, transfer-pricing policy documentation, beneficial-owner confirmations, consolidated group structure chart, tax registrations in home and receiving countries, supporting invoices, and a written explanation of the commercial purpose of each payment flow.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: Route all inbound capital only through a Belize licensed bank's USD account using SWIFT MT103/MT202 with the corporate name stated exactly as registered and the payment reference 'BZ IBC CAPITAL INJECTION - [Shareholder Name]'. The IMF BPM6 purpose code should be 'Direct investment — equity capital' and, if a shareholder loan is used, 'Direct investment — intercompany loan'. Belize exchange-control approval is not required for an exempt non-resident IBC if the funds remain in USD and no conversion to BZD occurs. The receiving bank's compliance team must hold the board resolution approving the share issuance/loan, the executed subscription or loan agreement, an updated share register, the source-of-funds statement from the remitting bank, and a UBO declaration. Wires should not be split into multiple small transactions; charges should be paid by the sender to avoid MT103 rejection.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: For operating disbursements to syrup, packaging, equipment, and logistics suppliers, use SWIFT MT103 with precise beneficiary details, invoice number, and purpose code 'Payment for goods and services'. For high-value bulk imports, use irrevocable commercial letters of credit governed by UCP600, issued by the Belize bank and advised through the beneficiary's bank. USD settlement should be cleared through the Belize bank's U.S. correspondent account via Fedwire or CHIPS; non-USD settlement should be executed over SWIFT-gpi. Local boba-shop proceeds received in Belize dollars can be collected through a Belize acquiring/POS merchant account and periodically converted to USD under the licensed bank's foreign-exchange facility. Every supplier payment must be matched against the purchase order, commercial invoice, bill of lading/airway bill, customs declaration, and inspection certificate where relevant; all documents must be retained for at least five years.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: USD/BZD outright forward contracts with a licensed Belize commercial bank, limited to genuine current-account and operational exposure
USD/BZD cross-currency swaps executed through a licensed Belize bank with Central Bank of Belize approval, used only where matched to approved BZD cash-flow exposure

Non-deliverable forwards (NDFs) for BZD/USD only where an authorized dealer provides a bespoke contract settled in USD; the market is extremely shallow and speculative NDFs are not permissible for an IBC treasury

FX options are not generally available or advisable for BZD due to the pegged exchange rate and shall not be used without Central Bank confirmation; treasury policy for this franchise should therefore follow a fully covered, no-leverage approach with hedging limited to forward conversion of operational BZD receipts

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual license fee (base-tier, authorized capital at or below USD 50,000) payable to maintain the Belize International Business Company
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Belize Companies Registry, International Business Companies Division (Registrar of Companies)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Anniversary of incorporation; annual fee is payable on or before the anniversary date each year under the International Business Companies Act, subject to any Registrar demand notice
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late penalty of 10% per month or part of a month on the unpaid annual license fee, capped at 100% of the fee; continued non-payment for three months may trigger administrative strike-off of the IBC and vesting of its assets in the Registrar.

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: None. A Belize IBC is not subject to mandatory audit under the International Business Companies Act based on revenue, assets, or share capital thresholds. An audit may only be required if chosen voluntarily, imposed by the company's own memorandum or articles, or requested by a lender, franchisor, or another commercial counterparty.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: No statutory financial reporting framework is prescribed for Belize IBCs. IFRS or US GAAP is commonly used where financial statements are voluntarily prepared; no IBC financial statements or accounts are required to be filed with the Belize Companies Registry.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: No annual public UBO filing is required with the Belize Companies Registry. The licensed registered agent must maintain current beneficial-ownership records at the company's registered office. Upon any share transfer or other change in beneficial ownership, the register of beneficial owners must be updated before or immediately upon completion of the transfer, and the agent must collect updated identification and source-of-funds documentation. The agent confirms the beneficial ownership profile through its annual AML/CFT internal compliance review and record certification to the Belize Financial Intelligence Unit where applicable.

recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.registered_office_or_agent_market_range_: USD 600–2,000 per annum for licensed registered agent and registered office services, depending on the service package and level of corporate secretarial support
recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.statutory_audit_estimated_fee_usd: USD 3,000–8,000 per annum for an optional independent audit or review of franchise royalty and syrup supply-chain financial statements, if such an audit is required by lenders or franchise agreements

corporate_income_tax_regime.statutory_headline_rate: 0% (IBC statutory exemption, s.6(1) International Business Companies Act, Cap. 270); domestic resident corporations: 25%
corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: Full exemption from income tax, business tax, capital gains tax and withholding taxes for non-resident-owned Belize International Business Companies; no Belize estate or gift tax on IBC shares; the 0% rate is conditioned on the IBC exercising no domestic trade or business in Belize unless an express election into the Income Tax Act is made.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: No Belize income tax return is required for an exempt IBC. The compliance filings are the Annual Government Licence Fee Renewal and the Declaration of Exempt Status submitted through the Belize Companies Registry e-Services portal and the International Financial Services Commission (IFSC) online system.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: The renewal and annual licence fee are due on or before the anniversary of incorporation (the last day of the month of incorporation). A company incorporated in December must renew by 31 December. The registered agent is the filing conduit for non-resident owners.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: IBC registered name, registration number and date of incorporation as shown on the Certificate of Incorporation.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Enter the IBC name exactly as registered; non-resident shareholders are not named on this line unless the registry portal requires a UBO reference.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Box B / Registered office and agent
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Belize physical registered office address and the name of the licensed Belize registered agent.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: The registered office cannot be a P.O. Box; the non-resident principal must engage the local agent to confirm the office is staffed during business hours.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Declaration that the company is an IBC, has not elected into the Belize Income Tax Act (s.6(5) IBC Act election), and carried on no domestic Belize trade or business during the year.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Franchise royalty income and syrup supply payments received from outside Belize are outside the declaration scope; if the company has inadvertently transacted domestically, immediate corrective disclosure is mandatory.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Box D / Director and beneficial owner schedule
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Register of directors and register of beneficial owners maintained by the registered agent under the Beneficial Ownership Act, 2019.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Non-resident ultimate beneficial owners must be identified through KYC documents held by the agent; the register is filed with the Registry but is not publicly accessible.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Box E / Annual licence fee computation
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Government licence fee scaled on authorised share capital bands (e.g., USD 150 per annum for authorised capital up to USD 50,000).
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Payment is typically made by the registered agent in USD or BZD; the non-resident is invoiced for the fee plus the agent's compliance service fee.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Late renewal penalty of 10% of the annual licence fee once default exceeds 30 days; continued default triggers administrative dissolution or striking-off of the IBC, a restoration fee of BZD 500–1,000, and personal liability of directors for debts incurred while the company is struck off.

profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.statutory_dividend_wht_rate: 0% — no Belize withholding tax is imposed on dividends paid by an exempt IBC (s.6(1) IBC Act Cap. 270); dividends paid to non-resident shareholders are also exempt from Belize income tax.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.treaty_relief_application_protocol: Belize has a limited DTA network (CARICOM Double Taxation Agreement and the bilateral arrangement with the United Kingdom inherited from colonial-era practice). To invoke treaty relief in a foreign payor jurisdiction, the IBC must obtain a Certificate of Residence from the Belize Tax Service, attach the foreign WHT form, and certify Belize economic substance. Because an exempt IBC is generally not 'liable to tax' in Belize, treaty residence may be contested by the treaty partner; in practice the IBC relies on the statutory 0% IBC exemption and uses an IFSC good-standing certificate plus substance evidence to support any foreign tax credit claim.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.cross_border_royalty_and_interest_wht: Statutory WHT on royalties and interest paid by an exempt IBC: 0%. For a domestic Belize company, the Income Tax Act generally imposes 15% WHT on royalties and 15% on interest to non-residents; the CARICOM DTA commonly limits source-state WHT on interest and royalties to 15%, and no reduced Belize treaty rate applies to IBCs because they are outside the charge to Belize tax.

transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.tp_documentation_threshold_local_currenc: No statutory BZD threshold applies to tax-exempt IBCs. For companies within the charge to Belize income tax, related-party transactions above BZD 1,000,000 (approximately USD 500,000) in annual aggregate value trigger mandatory Local File / Master File documentation. An IBC engaged in franchise licensing or syrup distribution must nonetheless maintain contemporaneous arm's-length data to support its Economic Substance Regulations return.
transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.economic_substance_doctrine: The Economic Substance Regulations (IFSC, Statutory Instrument 2019) apply to IBCs carrying on a Relevant Activity. The global boba tea franchise model comprises two Relevant Activities: (1) Intellectual Property holding and exploitation through franchise licensing of brand, recipes and trade secrets; and (2) Distribution and Service Centre through the syrup and concentrate supply chain. The IBC must be managed and controlled in Belize, maintain a physical office, engage adequate qualified staff, perform core income-generating activities in Belize and file an annual Economic Substance return with the IFSC; failure results in penalties, information exchange with foreign tax authorities, and potential striking-off.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Tax evasion / abuse of IBC exemption
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Using the IBC to conduct domestic Belize trade, deriving Belize-source income without the elective tax filing, or procuring the 0% regime through sham franchise licensing to shift profits from operating countries into Belize.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Assessment of tax at the 25% domestic corporation rate on undeclared profits, statutory interest on arrears, penalties of up to 100–300% of the tax (Income Tax Act, Cap. 55), and criminal fines of up to BZD 10,000; the IBC exemption is void for the offending period.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors and officers who knowingly caused, permitted or were party to the evasion are jointly and severally liable for corporate tax, penalties and interest; courts may impose travel bans, disqualification from holding a Belize directorship, and imprisonment for up to 5 years.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Maintaining nil office substance in Belize while booking IP royalties and supply-chain margins in the IBC; failing to file the ESR substance return; holding franchise IP without employees, premises or board meetings in Belize.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Penalty of BZD 10,000 per offence plus BZD 1,000 per month for continued default under the Economic Substance Regulations; the IFSC may exchange information with treaty partners, strike off the IBC, and refer a deemed-profit assessment of up to 1.2 times gross revenues.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors are personally liable for ESR penalties, restitution orders and enforcement costs; where the sham vehicle misrepresents a foreign franchisee's supply chain, the corporate veil is pierced, exposing directors to civil claims in the franchise territory, asset freezes and disqualification orders.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Failing to file beneficial ownership particulars with the Belize Companies Registry; processing unexplained franchise royalty wires without AML compliance; failure to conduct KYC on UBOs of the boba tea franchise chain or on nominee shareholders.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Monetary penalty of up to BZD 50,000 plus BZD 5,000 per day under the Beneficial Ownership Act, 2019 and the Banks and Financial Institutions Act; freeze orders and inspection by the IFSC; in money-laundering cases, confiscation of all royalty and syrup supply proceeds.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors are designated reporting persons and exposed to criminal prosecution for money laundering under the Proceeds of Crime Act with imprisonment of up to 12 years; travel bans, passport surrender and personal confiscation orders are routinely sought against non-resident directors.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Fraudulent trading / corporate veil abuse in franchise roll-out
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Misrepresenting IBC assets, collecting upfront franchise fees and syrup payments into the IBC while stripping profits to controllers, transacting with related shell companies at non-arm's-length prices, and abandoning franchisee contracts.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Civil restitution under the International Business Companies Act for fraudulent and wrongful trading; the Registrar or a appointed receiver may recover company property; foreign judgments may be recognised and enforced against Belize assets; criminal fraud and conspiracy charges carry fines of up to BZD 250,000.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: The court may order directors to contribute personally to company assets for every debt incurred in fraudulent trading; directors face bankruptcy orders, travel restrictions, extradition under bilateral arrangements, and imprisonment for fraud of up to 10 years.
